title: Ryobi S651D Sheet Sanders Recalled
summary: Ryobi and the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission have issued a voluntary recall for approximately 300,000 Ryobi S651D 1/4 sheet sanders. Pieces of the fan assembly can break off and be ejected, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Consumers should stop using the recalled sanders immediately and contact One World Technologies for a free replacement.

title: Amazon.com selling more e-books than printed books
summary: Amazon.com announced it is selling more electronic books than printed books, less than four years after introducing e-books. Since April 1, Amazon has sold 105 e-books for every 100 printed books, excluding free e-books. The company also noted its latest Kindle e-reader, priced at $114 with ads, is the best-selling device in its line.
